KEN.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.

facts.fact: The Technopolis Development Authority with the State Department for ICT launched the SecureKE Sovereign SOC, which uses AI-enabled analytics to identify suspicious activity across government networks, servers, endpoints and cloud.

KEN.note: The AI tool is for cybersecurity monitoring, not a sector's public system.
No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in Kenya is stated.

facts.fact: The PS for ICT, citing KE-CIRT/CC, said about 4.56 billion cyber threat events were recorded between October and December 2025.

systems.system: National Kenya Computer Incident Response Team Coordination Centre (KE-CIRT/CC)

KEN.note: A sovereign SOC is cybersecurity; no rule, hosting or contract terms on state data stated.
